Figure 7 (map). 의성·안동, 18:00 KST, 25 March 2025. (a) Leaving 원당리 at 18:00, a forward search settles 661 road pieces
before reaching a shelter at 18:06:27: one village, one departure time. (b) One backward pass from every shelter gives every
road its leave-by time, including both villages outside the fire area (분토리 18:05, 원당리 18:15).
